The novel masterfully blends the high stakes of legal drama with the paranoia of true crime investigation, making it an essential read for fans of dark suspense literature.

## The Story: A Performance in Danger

Claire Wright is struggling to make a name for herself. An aspiring actress in New York City without permanent residency, she takes any job offeredâeven one working for a law firm specializing in divorces. Her task: using her skills to "catch" unfaithful spouses within the glamorous settings of hotel bars.

But when one of her subjects becomes a suspect in a serious crime investigation, the entire game board flips. The police turn to Claire, asking her to leverage her acting talents to help make him testify. Suddenly, she finds herself questioning everything: Is Patrick Fogler truly a criminal? Or are there deep secrets hidden beneath the surface that no one dares to speak aloud? As Claire realizes she is playing the most dangerous role of her life, the lines between performance and reality blur into terrifying ambiguity.
